    cast('2' as UInt64)
 as row_id, 
    
    cast('2020-03-09 00:00:00' as DateTime('UTC'))
 as transaction_time, 
    
    cast('shop-2' as String)
 as merch, 
    
    cast('shopping_net' as String)
 as cat_id, 
    
    cast('10' as Float64)
 as amount, 
    
    cast('Ann' as String)
 as name_1, 
    
    cast('Smith' as String)
 as name_2, 
    
    cast('F' as String)
 as gender, 
    
    cast('CA' as String)
 as us_state, 
    
    cast('30' as Float64)
 as lat, 
    
    cast('-100' as Float64)
 as lon, 
    
    cast('30.1' as Float64)
 as merchant_lat, 
    
    cast('-100.1' as Float64)
 as merchant_lon, 
    
    cast('0' as UInt8)
 as target
), normalized as (
    select
        row_id,
        toDateTime(transaction_time, 'UTC') as transaction_time,
        trimBoth(merch) as merchant,
        lowerUTF8(trimBoth(cat_id)) as category,
        toDecimal64(toString(amount), 2) as amount,
        upperUTF8(trimBoth(name_1)) as first_name,
        upperUTF8(trimBoth(name_2)) as last_name,
        upperUTF8(trimBoth(gender)) as gender,
        upperUTF8(trimBoth(us_state)) as us_state,
        toFloat64(lat) as latitude,
        toFloat64(lon) as longitude,
        toFloat64(merchant_lat) as merchant_latitude,
        toFloat64(merchant_lon) as merchant_longitude,
        toUInt8(target) as is_fraud
    from `__dbt__cte__transactions`
)

select
    lower(hex(MD5(toString(coalesce(cast(row_id as String), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') )))) as transaction_id,
    lower(hex(MD5(toString(coalesce(cast(first_name as String), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') || '-' || coalesce(cast(last_name as String), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') || '-' || coalesce(cast(gender as String), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') || '-' || coalesce(cast(us_state as String), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') || '-' || coalesce(cast(latitude as String), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') || '-' || coalesce(cast(longitude as String), '_dbt_utils_surrogate_key_null_') )))) as customer_id,
    transaction_time,
    toDate(transaction_time) as transaction_date,
    toHour(transaction_time) as transaction_hour,
    toDayOfWeek(transaction_time) as day_of_week,
    toUInt8(toDayOfWeek(transaction_time) >= 6) as is_weekend,
    merchant,
    category,
    amount,
    case
        when amount is null then 'UNKNOWN'
        when amount < 0 then 'INVALID'
        when amount < 100 then 'SMALL'
        when amount < 1000 then 'MEDIUM'
        else 'LARGE'
    end as amount_bucket,
    toUInt8(amount >= 1000) as is_large,
    gender,
    us_state,
    latitude,
    longitude,
    merchant_latitude,
    merchant_longitude,
    is_fraud
from normalized
